cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've found our wedding video. Shall we watch it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Here's your father's speech. We never could agree what he meant by 'good luck'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant exactly this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paused. Let's skip to the dancing, then. No speeches. You can help me settle whether your uncle actually falls into the cake.
